paddy.label: Paddy
paddy.rule_sources: FAO Ecocrop pH; rainfed paddy only in high-rainfall (coastal/malnad) zones per UAS PoP; yield_factor converts DES rice to paddy (67% outturn)

maize.label: Maize
maize.rule_sources: FAO Ecocrop; TNAU Agritech (rabi maize irrigated)

jowar.label: Jowar (sorghum)
jowar.rule_sources: ICAR-IIMR: rabi sorghum on stored moisture of medium/deep black soils

groundnut.label: Groundnut
groundnut.rule_sources: ICAR-DGR: light/medium soils preferred; rabi groundnut irrigated

sunflower.label: Sunflower
sunflower.rule_sources: ICAR-IIOR: 3-4 year gap between sunflower crops

gram.label: Bengal gram (chickpea)
gram.rule_sources: ICAR-IIPR: chickpea on residual moisture; avoid continuous chickpea (wilt)

wheat.label: Wheat
wheat.rule_sources: ICAR-IIWBR: peninsular wheat irrigated; rainfed only on deep black soils

safflower.label: Safflower
safflower.rule_sources: ICAR-IIOR: rainfed rabi oilseed on deep black soils
